name: Sharing
overview: Scripture calls believers to a lifestyle of generous sharing that reflects Christ's love and unity among His people. Isaiah 58:7 and Luke 3:11 emphasize the responsibility to provide for the hungry, poor, and those in need, while Luke 6:29 and 6:38 teach a spirit of gracious giving without resistance, promising abundant blessings in return. The early church in Acts 4:32 exemplified this by holding all things in common, demonstrating genuine fellowship and mutual care. Romans 12:13 further encourages believers to meet the needs of fellow saints and practice hospitality, underscoring sharing as both a practical and spiritual expression of the gospel.
